content:
Whether you’re shopping for yourself, Father’s Day, or graduation season, Apple’s Beats brand makes a wide lineup of excellent options. Here are my top recommendations (with some big discounts).

We have partnered with Best Buy to promote Beats headphones at up to $190 off.

Beats Pill (from $71.99)

Loyal 9to5Mac readers will know I’m a huge fan of the Beats Pill, which made its triumphant return to the market in 2024. Since then, I’ve used my Beats Pill basically every day — and sometimes I even pair two of them together when I need an added boost.

As I wrote in my full review:

Thanks to that custom Beats chip inside, it can offer deeper integration with Apple platforms than any other Bluetooth speaker on the market.

The Beats Pill gets almost everything right for a revival of an abandoned, fan-favorite product. It stays true to its iconic roots while also making several notable improvements. That includes better sound quality, improved battery life, improved connectivity, and USB-C.

And what makes those improvements all the more notable is the pricing.

Beats Pill normally retails for $149.99, but Best Buy is running some killer deals right now:

  • Statement Red Beats Pill (Open-Box Excellent): $71.99
  • Matte Black Beats Pill (Open-Box Excellent): $76.99
  • Beats Pill (brand new): $99.99

Powerbeats Pro 2

The Powerbeats Pro 2 were the first Apple headphones to feature a built-in heart rate monitor, integrating with third-party apps and Apple’s own Fitness app. Plus, they feature a workout-friendly earhook design that keeps them in place no matter what workout you’re doing.

Here’s what I wrote about Powerbeats Pro 2 in my full review:

Powerbeats Pro 2 are the perfect iteration of the product line. They maintain the fan-favorite design while simultaneously making key improvements to the form factor, like the slimmer earbuds and smaller charging case. Battery life is stellar and performance is excellent thanks to the H2 chip. The secure fit is still unmatched.

The Powerbeats Pro 2 release is the latest piece of evidence that Beats is firing on all cylinders right now. They represent the company’s most ambitious product yet, combining a significant form factor revamp and first-of-its-kind heart rate monitoring technology.

Powerbeats Pro 2 normally retail for $250, but they are on sale for Father’s Day and graduation season right now:

  • Powerbeats Pro 2: $200 (Reg. $250)

Studio Pro

If you’re looking for a pair of over-ear headphones that are far more affordable than Apple’s AirPods Max, the Beats Studio Pro are an excellent option.

Here’s what I wrote in my full review:

I’ve been testing the Beats Studio Pro for the past week, and they stay true to the expectations Beats has set with all of its recent products. That is: They pack a range of impressive features at a lower price than Apple’s alternatives but with a couple of omissions that could leave Apple users frustrated.

That being said: The features offered by Beats Studio Pro – and not offered by AirPods Max – make Apple’s over-ear headphones virtually impossible to recommend for now. Oh, and the Beats Studio Pro are cheaper and include a 3.5mm headphone cable in the box.

Beats Studio Pro retail for $350, but you can get them on sale right now:

  • Beats Studio Pro ANC Headphones Navy (Open-Box Excellent): $129.99
  • Beats Studio Pro ANC Headphones Black/Gold (Open-Box Excellent): $137.99
  • Beats Studio Pro Headphones (Brand new): from $159.99
